name: Passive Resistor — I2C — SOT
description: Surface-mount passive resistor components featuring I2C interface support in SOT-353 (SC-70-5) and SOT-363 (SC-70-6) footprints.
selection_hints: Select between SOT-353 (SC-70-5) and SOT-363 (SC-70-6) footprint options.
Verify part model requirements among MCP4017, MCP4018, or MCP4019 variants.
Confirm that an I2C communication interface is required for the application.
avoid_when: Through-hole mounting is required rather than surface-mount (SMD).
Packages other than SOT-353 or SOT-363 are needed.
A non-I2C interface or a standard fixed resistor without digital control is required.
